scripts.title: Loot  AutoFarm
scripts.features:
Script developed by Legazyhax19
Built upon the original Autofarm menu by S*ch_Aloha (original credit)

Script v2
====================================================
New Additions
AutoHatch System – Automatically hatches selected eggs when enough coins are available
Rarity Filter System – Filter loot collection by rarity with priority sorting (Secret > Mythic > Legendary > Rare > UnCommon > Common)
====================================================
Main Tab
Select Island / Plot 
– Change your island and plot manually
Auto Detect My Plot 
– Automatically finds the plot you own
Adjust Teleport Delay 
– Set delay between teleports when collecting loot (0–1 sec)
Collect & Home Button 
– Teleports to each loot item (filtered by rarity), collects them, then returns to SafeZone
Home Button 
– Teleports directly to your plot's SafeZone
Split Button 
– Equips stick (if needed), goes to SplitZone, and performs split
Sell All Button 
– Sells all items in your inventory
Auto Farm System
 – Fully automated loop
====================================================
Filter Tab
Filter by Rarity 
– Toggle which rarities to collect (Priority order: Secret > Mythic > Legendary > Rare > UnCommon > Common) 
====================================================
Pet Farm Tab (Auto Hatch)
Egg dropdown 
– Shows egg names and their coin prices
Hatch Once Button 
– Hatches the selected egg once (checks if you have enough coins)
Auto Hatch Toggle 
– Automatically hatches the selected egg whenever you have enough coins
Status display 
– Shows selected egg, hatching status, or insufficient coins warning
====================================================
Keybinds Tab
Collect & Home (Default: G)
Home (Default: F)
Split (Default: H)
Toggle Auto Farm (Default: J)
Sell All (Default: K)

When Auto Farm is active, other keybinds are ignored to prevent interference.
====================================================

scripts.title: Loot Split AutoFarm
scripts.features:
Graphical User Interface (GUI)
Modern dark-themed draggable window with minimize/restore button
Status bar showing current island + plot in real-time
Customizable teleport delay input field
Visual separators for better readability
Log window with real-time action feedback

Island & Plot Selection
Dropdown menus to manually select working island and plot
Automatic detection of your owned plot every ~5 seconds
Updates GUI and status label when plot/island changes

Manual Controls
Collect — teleports to all loot on your plot (≤ 800 studs radius)
Home — teleports to SafeZone (delivery point)
Sell All — instantly sells everything via remote event
Split — equips stick → moves to SplitZone → performs split

Keyboard Hotkeys (fully rebindable)
Default binds:
G → Collect + auto Home
F → Home (SafeZone)
H → Split
K → Sell All
J → Toggle Auto Farm

Click-to-rebind system with visual feedback (“[...]” state)
Hotkeys shown on buttons for quick reference

Auto Farm Mode (fully automated loop)
Toggle with button or hotkey (J)
Smart cycle:
Home (deliver)
Split (with retry logic — up to 3 attempts)
Wait for loot to spawn (timeout protection)
Collect everything nearby
Home (deliver again)
Sell All
Repeat

Handles failed splits and leftover loot automatically
Visual ON/OFF state + color change on button
